== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Ninecloud]] [[Court]] is a prominent human-dominated faction located within the [[Ninecloud Country]]. Its capital, [[Ninecloud City]], is a massive metropolis characterized by its vibrant, rainbow-colored architecture and jeweled towers that remain brightly lit even at night. The [[Court]] is known for its immense wealth, ostentatious displays of color, and advanced technology, including the production of cloud fortresses equipped with sophisticated navigation and [[security scripts]]. It also hosts significant events, such as the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]], which takes place in specialized arenas and viewing towers. The [[Court]] is overseen by the [[Luminous Queen]], [[Luminous Queen Sha Leiala|Sha Leiala]], and utilizes a collective entity known as the [[Ninecloud Soul]] to coordinate its [[constructs]], manage security, and communicate with guests. While highly impressive in [[scale]] and splendor, some observers view the faction as a threadbare group struggling to maintain its cohesion.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Located within [[Ninecloud City]], the [[Ninecloud]] [[Court]] serves as the host for the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]]. Prior to the event, the faction provided superior navigational and propulsion [[constructs]] to the [[Akura clan]] and offered fourteen days of hospitality within a tower, including [[Monarch]]'s hospitality for [[Lindon]]. The venue features a viewing tower constructed of stained glass and [[Forged madra]], where staff members select visions to share with the audience. Throughout the competition, the [[Court]] provides protection and enforcement while maintaining decorated training rooms and methods for restoring souls. The faction is associated with [[Luminous Queen Sha Miara|Sha Miara]], holds most of the top ten [[tournament]] ranks, and prepared a battlefield for two [[Blackflame|Blackflames]].}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Ninecloud]] [[Court]] is an opulent location led by the [[Luminous Queen]] and associated with a rainbow-shrouded [[Monarch]]. Its audience hall, which serves as a gathering place for [[Monarchs]], is characterized by pillars and colored tiles. While [[Lindon]] spent time within its hallways before being ushered away by [[Charity]], the court also offers broad, open training rooms. The entity has formally announced its support for [[Reigan Shen]] and provided a present for [[Yerin]].}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Ninecloud]] [[Court]] is a location where [[Lindon]] and his companions stay, characterized by its core value of friendship. This site features an [[Akura tower]] and is capable of producing cloud fortresses that can be equipped with redundant [[security scripts]]. During their stay, [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] managed to obtain various herbs from the area. The court also utilizes high-quality [[viewing constructs]] to release recordings of tournaments. Following their time there, the group departed the [[Ninecloud]] [[Court]] in the morning.}}
